<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover, user-scalable=no">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Pokédex Typing">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#A8232B">
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.webmanifest">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="apple-touch-icon.png">
<link rel="icon" href="icon-192.png">
<title>Pokédex Typing</title>
<style>
:root{
  --shell:#A8232B; --shell-dk:#6E1219; --lcd:#D3E0B8; --lcd-dk:#1F3320; --lcd-mid:#7E9770; --amber:#F2C230;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0}
body{background:var(--shell-dk);color:var(--lcd-dk);font-family:var(--mono);overscroll-behavior:none;
  padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) env(safe-area-inset-right) env(safe-area-inset-bottom) env(safe-area-inset-left)}
.device{height:100%;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--shell);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding:12px;
  border-left:3px solid var(--shell-dk);border-right:3px solid var(--shell-dk)}
.top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:#fff}
.lens{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%,#9fe3ff,#1b78c9 60%,#0c3f78);border:3px solid #fff;flex:none}
.top h1{font-size:15px;margin:0;flex:1}
.ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff;box-shadow:none;border:2px solid #fff;padding:6px 12px;font-size:13px}
.field{position:relative}
#inp{width:100%;font:700 20px var(--mono);text-align:center;padding:14px;border-radius:999px;border:3px solid var(--shell-dk);background:#fff;color:#111;outline:none}
#inp:focus{border-color:var(--amber)}
.sug{position:absolute;left:8px;right:8px;top:calc(100% + 6px);z-index:30;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:6px;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35);display:none}
.sug.on{display:block}
.sug li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;color:#111}
.sug li.sel{background:var(--lcd)}
.sug img{width:40px;height:40px;object-fit:contain}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.chip{background:var(--shell-dk);color:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 12px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.chip.combo{background:var(--amber);color:#2a1d00}
.chip.time{margin-left:auto;background:transparent;padding-right:0}
.screen{flex:1;min-height:0;background:var(--lcd);border:4px solid var(--shell-dk);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--lcd-mid)}
.bar{height:8px;background:var(--lcd-mid);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--lcd-dk);transition:width .15s}
.prog{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px;margin-top:5px}
.target{text-align:center}
.target .q{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--lcd-mid)}
.target .no{font-size:52px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pop{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;min-height:18px}
.cards{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;align-content:start}
.card{background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 4px 8px;text-align:center;position:relative}
.card img{width:64px;height:64px;object-fit:contain;display:block;margin:0 auto}
.card .n{position:absolute;left:6px;top:4px;font-size:11px;color:#555}
.card b{font-size:13px;color:#111}
.overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--lcd);padding:16px;display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;overflow:auto;z-index:5}
.overlay.on{display:flex}
.overlay h2{margin:0;font-size:24px}
.overlay p{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5}
.answer{background:var(--lcd-dk);color:var(--lcd);border-radius:8px;padding:12px}
.answer b{font-size:26px;display:block;margin-top:2px}
.answer small{display:block;margin-top:4px;opacity:.8}
.answer img{width:96px;height:96px;display:block;margin-top:6px}
.rules{padding-left:18px;margin:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45}
.rules li{margin-bottom:6px}
.spacer{flex:1}
button{font:700 16px var(--mono);border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 18px;background:var(--amber);color:#2a1d00;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #a07d0f;cursor:pointer}
button:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #a07d0f}
.shake{animation:sh .35s}
@keyframes sh{20%{transform:translateX(-6px)}40%{transform:translateX(6px)}60%{transform:translateX(-4px)}80%{transform:translateX(4px)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.shake{animation:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main class="device">
  <div class="top"><div class="lens"></div><h1>POKÉDEX TYPING · 151</h1><button class="ghost" id="quit">Desistir!</button></div>

  <div class="field">
    <input id="inp" type="text" enterkeyhint="go" autocomplete="off" autocorrect="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false"
      placeholder="Escreva aqui..." aria-label="Nome do Pokémon" disabled>
    <ul class="sug" id="sug" role="listbox"></ul>
  </div>

  <div class="chips">
    <span class="chip" id="score">0 pontos</span>
    <span class="chip combo" id="combo">Combo x0</span>
    <span class="chip time" id="time">0:00</span>
  </div>

  <section class="screen" id="screen">
    <div>
      <div class="bar"><i id="barfill"></i></div>
      <div class="prog"><span id="count">0 / 151</span><span id="best">Recorde: 0</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="target">
      <div class="q">QUAL É O POKÉMON?</div>
      <div class="no" id="no">Nº 001</div>
      <div class="pop" id="pop"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="cards" id="cards"></div>

    <div class="overlay on" id="start">
      <h2>Treinador</h2>
      <p>Digite os 151 Pokémon da primeira geração na ordem da Pokédex.</p>
      <ul class="rules">
        <li>Escreva o nome e toque na sugestão (ou aperte Enter para escolher a primeira).</li>
        <li>Digitar o nome certo por inteiro também avança sozinho.</li>
        <li>Pontuação: cada acerto vale o valor do combo. 1º acerto = 1 ponto, 2º = 2, 3º = 3…</li>
        <li>Escolheu o Pokémon errado? Fim de jogo, e você vê qual era o próximo.</li>
        <li>Maiúsculas, acentos e símbolos não importam.</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="spacer"></div>
      <button id="go">Começar</button>
    </div>

    <div class="overlay" id="over">
      <h2 id="ovtitle">Fim de jogo</h2>
      <div class="answer" id="ovans"></div>
      <p id="ovsum"></p>
      <div class="spacer"></div>
      <button id="again">Jogar de novo</button>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<script>
const NAMES = ["Bulbasaur","Ivysaur","Venusaur","Charmander","Charmeleon","Charizard","Squirtle","Wartortle","Blastoise","Caterpie","Metapod","Butterfree","Weedle","Kakuna","Beedrill","Pidgey","Pidgeotto","Pidgeot","Rattata","Raticate","Spearow","Fearow","Ekans","Arbok","Pikachu","Raichu","Sandshrew","Sandslash","Nidoran♀","Nidorina","Nidoqueen","Nidoran♂","Nidorino","Nidoking","Clefairy","Clefable","Vulpix","Ninetales","Jigglypuff","Wigglytuff","Zubat","Golbat","Oddish","Gloom","Vileplume","Paras","Parasect","Venonat","Venomoth","Diglett","Dugtrio","Meowth","Persian","Psyduck","Golduck","Mankey","Primeape","Growlithe","Arcanine","Poliwag","Poliwhirl","Poliwrath","Abra","Kadabra","Alakazam","Machop","Machoke","Machamp","Bellsprout","Weepinbell","Victreebel","Tentacool","Tentacruel","Geodude","Graveler","Golem","Ponyta","Rapidash","Slowpoke","Slowbro","Magnemite","Magneton","Farfetch'd","Doduo","Dodrio","Seel","Dewgong","Grimer","Muk","Shellder","Cloyster","Gastly","Haunter","Gengar","Onix","Drowzee","Hypno","Krabby","Kingler","Voltorb","Electrode","Exeggcute","Exeggutor","Cubone","Marowak","Hitmonlee","Hitmonchan","Lickitung","Koffing","Weezing","Rhyhorn","Rhydon","Chansey","Tangela","Kangaskhan","Horsea","Seadra","Goldeen","Seaking","Staryu","Starmie","Mr. Mime","Scyther","Jynx","Electabuzz","Magmar","Pinsir","Tauros","Magikarp","Gyarados","Lapras","Ditto","Eevee","Vaporeon","Jolteon","Flareon","Porygon","Omanyte","Omastar","Kabuto","Kabutops","Aerodactyl","Snorlax","Articuno","Zapdos","Moltres","Dratini","Dragonair","Dragonite","Mewtwo","Mew"];
const SPR = ["data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,"];
const TOTAL = NAMES.length;
// comparação sempre em minúsculas, sem acentos nem símbolos
const norm = s => s.toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"").replace(/♀/g,"f").replace(/♂/g,"m").replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,"");
const KEYS = NAMES.map(norm);
const ALT = {28:["nidoranfemale","nidoranfemea"],31:["nidoranmale","nidoranmacho"]};
const matches = (i,v) => v===KEYS[i] || (ALT[i]||[]).includes(v);
const pad = i => String(i+1).padStart(3,"0");
const img = (i,cls) => SPR[i] ? '<img src="'+SPR[i]+'" alt="">' : "";

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const inp=$("inp"), sug=$("sug");
let idx=0, score=0, combo=0, startT=0, timer=null, running=false, best=0, sugList=[], sel=0;
try{ best = parseInt(localStorage.getItem("pokedex-typing-best")||"0",10)||0; }catch(e){}
$("best").textContent = "Recorde: "+best;

const fmt = ms => { const s=Math.floor(ms/1000); return Math.floor(s/60)+":"+String(s%60).padStart(2,"0"); };
const pts = n => n+(n===1?" ponto":" pontos");

function render(){
  $("score").textContent = pts(score);
  $("combo").textContent = "Combo x"+combo;
  $("count").textContent = idx+" / "+TOTAL;
  $("barfill").style.width = (idx/TOTAL*100)+"%";
  $("no").textContent = idx<TOTAL ? "Nº "+pad(idx) : "Nº ---";
}

function hideSug(){ sug.classList.remove("on"); sug.innerHTML=""; sugList=[]; }
function drawSug(){
  sug.innerHTML = sugList.map((i,k)=>'<li data-i="'+i+'" class="'+(k===sel?"sel":"")+'">'+img(i)+NAMES[i]+'</li>').join("");
  sug.classList.toggle("on", sugList.length>0);
}
function showSug(v){
  if(!v){ hideSug(); return; }
  const a=[], b=[];
  KEYS.forEach((k,i)=>{ if(k.startsWith(v)) a.push(i); else if(k.includes(v)) b.push(i); });
  sugList=[...a,...b].slice(0,5); sel=0; drawSug();
}

function begin(){
  idx=0; score=0; combo=0; running=true; startT=Date.now();
  $("start").classList.remove("on"); $("over").classList.remove("on");
  $("cards").innerHTML=""; $("pop").textContent="";
  inp.disabled=false; inp.value=""; hideSug(); render();
  clearInterval(timer);
  timer=setInterval(()=>{ $("time").textContent = fmt(Date.now()-startT); },250);
  inp.focus();
}

function correct(){
  combo++; score += combo;           // cada acerto vale o combo atual: 1, 2, 3, 4…
  $("pop").textContent = "+"+pts(combo);
  $("cards").insertAdjacentHTML("afterbegin",
    '<div class="card">'+img(idx)+'<span class="n">'+(idx+1)+'</span><b>'+NAMES[idx]+'</b></div>');
  idx++; inp.value=""; hideSug(); render();
  if(idx>=TOTAL) finish(true);
}

function choose(i){
  if(!running) return;
  if(i===idx) correct(); else finish(false, NAMES[i]);
}

function finish(won, typed){
  running=false; clearInterval(timer);
  const total=Date.now()-startT;
  $("time").textContent=fmt(total);
  inp.disabled=true; inp.blur(); hideSug();
  let isBest=false;
  if(score>best){ best=score; isBest=true; try{localStorage.setItem("pokedex-typing-best",String(best));}catch(e){} }
  $("best").textContent="Recorde: "+best;
  $("ovtitle").textContent = won ? "Mestre Pokémon!" : "Fim de jogo";
  const esc = s => s.replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;");
  $("ovans").innerHTML = won ? "Você completou os 151 sem errar nenhum."
    : "O próximo era<b>#"+pad(idx)+" "+NAMES[idx]+"</b>"+img(idx)+(typed?"<small>Você escolheu: “"+esc(typed)+"”</small>":"");
  $("ovsum").innerHTML = "Pontos: <b>"+score+"</b>"+(isBest?" (novo recorde!)":"")+"<br>Acertos: "+idx+" de "+TOTAL+"<br>Combo final: x"+combo+"<br>Tempo: "+fmt(total);
  $("over").classList.add("on");
  if(!won){ const s=$("screen"); s.classList.remove("shake"); void s.offsetWidth; s.classList.add("shake"); }
}

inp.addEventListener("input",()=>{
  if(!running) return;
  const v=norm(inp.value);
  if(v && matches(idx,v)){ correct(); return; }   // nome certo por inteiro avança sozinho
  showSug(v);
});
inp.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
  if(!running) return;
  if(e.key==="ArrowDown"&&sugList.length){ e.preventDefault(); sel=(sel+1)%sugList.length; drawSug(); }
  else if(e.key==="ArrowUp"&&sugList.length){ e.preventDefault(); sel=(sel-1+sugList.length)%sugList.length; drawSug(); }
  else if(e.key==="Enter"){
    e.preventDefault();
    if(sugList.length) choose(sugList[sel]);
    else if(inp.value.trim()) finish(false, inp.value.trim());
  }
});
// pointerdown + preventDefault mantém o teclado aberto ao tocar numa sugestão
sug.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const li=e.target.closest("li"); if(li) choose(parseInt(li.dataset.i,10));
});
$("quit").addEventListener("click",()=>{ if(running) finish(false); });
$("go").addEventListener("click",begin);
$("again").addEventListener("click",begin);
render();

if("serviceWorker" in navigator && location.protocol.indexOf("http")===0){
  window.addEventListener("load",()=>navigator.serviceWorker.register("./sw.js").catch(()=>{}));
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
